title: Contributions to US PCE inflation
subtitle: Understand price inflation through its individual drivers.
headline: Headline PCE
chartSubtitle: Bars: contributions in percentage points. Lines: headline and core inflation (%).
detailSubtitle: Compare expenditure shares, own price changes and contributions to headline inflation.
tableNote: Product contributions are reconstructed Fisher estimates. Shares are current-month nominal expenditure shares. Deductions have negative shares; parents overlap their children.
source: Source: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis
footer: Seasonally adjusted · History is subject to revision
methodSubtitle: Official contributions and detailed estimates are identified separately. All residuals are retained.
sourcesText: Monthly contributions: BEA 2.8.8. Detailed products: seasonally adjusted price indexes in 2.4.4U and nominal spending in 2.4.5U. MoM is not annualized; YoY also uses seasonally adjusted prices. Restaurant services are core services. Energy includes energy goods, electricity and gas.
chainText: Yearly contributions are not a simple sum of twelve monthly contributions. Each month is converted into a price-level change relative to the previous year using the headline price index. This is a project allocation method, not an official BEA yearly contribution series.
fisherText: PCE uses a chain-type Fisher index. Estimates use adjacent expenditure shares and price relatives, with signed spending for deductions. Contributions sum exactly to the reconstructed index, which may differ from the official calculation. Residuals are retained and never redistributed.
checksText: The pipeline checks the BEA vintage, main-vs-underlying prices and spending, spending coverage, group classification and hierarchy. Failed downloads or mismatched vintages stop the update without treating stale cache as new data.
chartHint: Select a bar to inspect that month. Changing the breakdown does not change headline inflation.
